        Playing the real Contexto elsewhere? Type the ranks it gave you. Each one narrows which word fits.

          No ranks yet. Start with a broad word — water, money, city — and enter whatever number comes back.

          Place any number of words against one main word, to see which of two guesses is worth a turn.

          How the ranks are made. Every word here carries a hundred numbers, blended from two models: GloVe, which read six billion words of Wikipedia and newswire and learned what keeps company with what, and counter-fitted vectors, tuned so that words meaning the same thing sit together while merely-related ones drift apart. Two words are scored by the angle between them, then all thirty thousand are sorted against the target. Rank 1 is the word itself.

          The whole model runs in this page. Nothing is sent anywhere, and it works with no connection.
